biomes.name: 灯市后巷
biomes.environment: MIDNIGHT LANTERN MARKET: glowing vermilion and saturated honey amber against dark aubergine shadows
biomes.floor_material: reddish cherry-wood planks with pale worn seams
biomes.architecture: crowded wooden shop fronts, scalloped red awnings, tightly clustered round lanterns; narrow urban silhouettes
variants: lantern-maker lane: staggered timber stalls and round paper lamps, long plank floor
festival delivery court: overhead zigzag lamp garlands and rolled awnings, herringbone timber floor

biomes.name: 纸渡河埠
biomes.environment: BLUE RIVER FERRY: deep indigo water, sea-teal timber and bright cyan reflections; strong cold blue identity
biomes.floor_material: weathered blue-green wooden dock planks, water visible around every edge
biomes.architecture: wooden piers floating on an indigo river, ferry slips, paper boats and mooring posts; no stone courtyard walls
variants: outer ferry dock: parallel pier planks and folded ferry boats at the water rim
tide terminal: cross-braced pontoon deck and curved jade water channels, dock-rope perimeter

biomes.name: 铜钱旧库
biomes.environment: GOLDEN COIN TREASURY: ochre gold, golden brass and dark chocolate; keep golden-yellow floor dominant
biomes.floor_material: matte golden coin-mosaic tiles with square cash motifs
biomes.architecture: round bronze vault doors, stacked coin cylinders and low bullion shelves; circular treasury geometry
variants: cash vault: square-hole coin mosaic, thick round brass arches
mint workshop: burnished brass diamond floor, coin-press wheels and rounded racks at the perimeter

biomes.name: 苔庭香径
biomes.environment: LIVING SPRING GARDEN: bright fern green, moss lime and warm soft sunlight; luminous organic green floor
biomes.floor_material: living moss carpet, fern-leaf imprints and irregular ivory stepping slabs
biomes.architecture: rounded hedge arches, fern planters, spreading tree roots and low woven garden gates; open-air garden without temple masonry
variants: fern sanctuary: bright moss clearing with petal stepping stones and rounded hedge borders
root courtyard: lime-green leafy floor, a curved path and flowering root arches at the rim

biomes.name: 墨雨书院
biomes.environment: INK RAIN ACADEMY: desaturated storm blue, slate navy and chalk white; blue-black scholarly atmosphere
biomes.floor_material: blue-black lacquer boards with pale paper scroll inlays and loose brush-stroke patterns
biomes.architecture: tall ink-stained bookcases, folded blue roof eaves, hanging blank scrolls and ink gutters; no lantern market palette
variants: rain reading court: blue slate scroll floor with shelving bays and dripping eaves
calligraphy study: pale blue-gray parchment grid floor, inkstone trays and tall brush racks at the rim

biomes.name: 赤绫戏楼
biomes.environment: PLUM OPERA THEATRE: saturated magenta, mulberry purple, rose silk and charcoal stage wood
biomes.floor_material: polished dark plum stage boards with a dusty rose circular stage medallion
biomes.architecture: layered magenta theatrical curtains, scalloped silk proscenium, carved wooden mask racks and stage wings
variants: front stage: purple rose radial stage floor and magenta draped side wings
backstage rehearsal: aubergine diagonal stage boards, rose canopy and tall folding scenery panels

biomes.name: 烛骨礼堂
biomes.environment: PALE WAX CHAPEL: bone ivory, cream, parchment beige and restrained amber; bright pale floor dominates
biomes.floor_material: smooth cream wax tiles with flowing drip-shaped seams
biomes.architecture: melted ivory wax columns, soft rounded candle arches, low candle trays; no red cloth and no gray masonry
variants: wax nave: pale cream long tiles, wax stalactite arches and many small amber candles
candle reliquary: ivory concentric wax floor with irregular drip-edged alcoves and short wax pillars

biomes.name: 雷鼓山门
biomes.environment: VIOLET THUNDER GATE: electric cobalt, violet rock and flashes of icy lilac; unmistakable purple-blue storm arena
biomes.floor_material: cracked dark violet mountain slabs with thin luminous cobalt thunder veins
biomes.architecture: jagged mountain gate silhouette, monumental violet ceremonial drums, zigzag thunder rods, storm-cloud rim; no warm red shrine
variants: storm pass: jagged violet basalt floor and diagonal cobalt thunder veins, exposed cloud edges
drum summit: circular blue-violet drum-skin floor surrounded by rock teeth and large storm drums

biomes.name: 灰窑遗坊
biomes.environment: COPPER KILN WORKS: charcoal black, fired-clay terracotta and blazing copper-orange; industrial furnace identity
biomes.floor_material: charcoal brick floor with muted copper heat seams and broad clay tiles
biomes.architecture: round clay kilns, black chimney silhouettes, rusted kiln rails and orange furnace mouths; no temple altars
variants: firing yard: long burnt-clay brick lanes with charcoal kiln mouths at the perimeter
pottery workshop: dark clay hexagonal slabs and low copper rails, glazed terracotta urn shelves

biomes.name: 莲灯水阁
biomes.environment: AQUAMARINE LOTUS PAVILION: luminous turquoise, mint-green jade and pearl-white lotus; a light watery theme
biomes.floor_material: pale turquoise jade deck with shallow translucent aquamarine water channels
biomes.architecture: curved mint-painted pavilion rails, large pearl lotus lamps, lily ponds and gently arched jade bridges
variants: lotus pool deck: mint jade petal floor and curved water channels, pearl lotus edge lamps
water pavilion: aquamarine geometric deck with shallow surrounding pools and sweeping jade railings

biomes.name: 白绫桥院
biomes.environment: SILVER FUNERAL BRIDGE: icy powder blue, frost white and silver-gray; cold airy high-key palette
biomes.floor_material: pale blue alabaster bridge deck, soft silver joints and a faint frost-paper pattern
biomes.architecture: long suspended white silk ribbons, pale blue bridge railings and cold mist void beyond; no vermilion temple walls
variants: silk bridge: long pale blue-white alabaster deck, flowing white funeral cloth at the sides
mourning terrace: silver-white diamond slabs, looped white silk canopy and blue-gray mist beneath

biomes.name: 钟楼余响
biomes.environment: SUNLIT BRASS BELL TOWER: mustard yellow, warm ochre timber and weathered golden brass; mechanical tower identity
biomes.floor_material: warm mustard oak boards and circular brass gear inlays
biomes.architecture: huge round bells, interlocking paper-cut gear silhouettes, wooden clock beams and counterweight ropes
variants: bell chamber: ochre oak radial planks and a broad brass circle, hanging bells at the rim
counterweight loft: yellow-brown checker timber floor, curved gears and suspended wooden weights

biomes.name: 竹影契林
biomes.environment: DEEP BAMBOO FOREST: bottle green, sap green and sharp yellow-green dappled light; vertical bamboo silhouette
biomes.floor_material: dark green packed forest earth, fine bamboo-leaf litter and dappled lime sunlight
biomes.architecture: dense upright bamboo stems, segmented bamboo gates, woven reed fences and roots; no stone hall
variants: bamboo glade: dark emerald earthen clearing with narrow lime light slashes and dense reed edges
pledge grove: olive-green leaf floor and bent bamboo archways, yellow-green canopy light patches

biomes.name: 镜池回廊
biomes.environment: MIDNIGHT MIRROR GALLERY: near-black navy, cold ice cyan and reflective indigo; smooth geometric mirror identity
biomes.floor_material: smooth navy obsidian mirror tiles with thin cyan seams and subtle reflections
biomes.architecture: angular cyan mirror panels, dark reflecting pools and geometric crystalline archways; no ivory candle chapel
variants: reflection hall: deep navy square mirror floor, cyan-lit triangular mirror walls
obsidian pool gallery: indigo diamond mirror floor with crescent pools and upright broken mirror fins

biomes.name: 封印石牢
biomes.environment: AMETHYST SEAL PRISON: deep grape purple, near-black plum and glowing magenta runes; heavy angular confinement
biomes.floor_material: large angular dark amethyst slabs with faint glowing violet geometric seal seams
biomes.architecture: massive purple runestone blocks, chains, narrow angular cell doors and suspended magenta seal cords; no ordinary gray walls
variants: sealed cell block: large purple slabs and square carved seals, massive angular cell rim
binding vault: plum polygonal floor and radiating magenta seal seams, chain-weight alcoves

biomes.name: 万签焚堂
biomes.environment: ASHEN PETITION PYRE: soot black, ash white and dry rusty ember-red; paper rubble and burned timber
biomes.floor_material: scorched black wooden boards covered in pale torn blank petition fragments
biomes.architecture: charred timber ribs, curled burnt paper piles, slashed broken roof and ash chimneys; ruin rather than a neat temple courtyard
variants: burned petition hall: black timber floor with white ash scatter, collapsed charred roof ribs
ash archive: ash-gray torn paper floor with long rust-red scorched seams and blackened scroll racks

biomes.name: 绳塔悬阁
biomes.environment: SKYBLUE ROPE SKY LOFT: clear cerulean, cloud white and pale blond timber; bright open sky around every edge
biomes.floor_material: pale weathered suspended wooden platform with rope-seam square sections
biomes.architecture: floating rope-tied timber platforms over a blue cloud abyss, rope balustrades and high suspension spars; NO enclosing masonry or shrine ceiling
variants: hanging sky deck: pale blond timber platform, vivid blue sky and torn white cloud edges
rope loft: beige rope-weave floor panels, skyblue abyss and slanting suspension cable silhouettes

biomes.name: 无名陵园
biomes.environment: MOONLIT NAMELESS CEMETERY: desaturated moon-cyan, blue-green gray and silver fog; irregular quiet graveyard
biomes.floor_material: blue-green moonlit gravel and moss with irregular blank slate grave markers at the rim
biomes.architecture: low eroded headstones, crooked cypress silhouettes, broken moon gates and ground fog; open outdoor cemetery
variants: moon grave court: cool cyan gravel clearing and staggered blank gravestones, mist behind cypress trees
forgotten burial garden: gray-teal moss earth and broken circular moon gate, scattered low blank stone plaques

biomes.name: 守名判殿
biomes.environment: REGAL MAGISTRATE COURT: deep ruby lacquer, ceremonial red-brown wood and old bronze-gold; massive solemn palace
biomes.floor_material: dark ruby lacquer geometric court tiles with restrained symmetrical bronze lines
biomes.architecture: monumental symmetrical bronze scales, tall ruby palace columns, huge seal-shaped throne alcove; more imposing than the small lantern market
variants: name-weighing court: dark ruby rectangular tiles and a giant bronze balance behind the north entrance
verdict hall: ruby-black diamond court floor, bronze scale pillars and a broad monumental throne outline

biomes.name: 万愿天穹
biomes.environment: COSMIC LEDGER VOID: midnight violet, starlight gold and pale lavender; celestial space, never an ordinary temple
biomes.floor_material: floating dark-violet paper-ledger plane with tiny gold constellation seams and lavender page corners
biomes.architecture: disconnected floating ivory page islands, bronze celestial arcs, red-thread constellations and deep starry void beyond all four edges; NO masonry walls
variants: constellation page: violet star-map floor and scattered floating ivory page islands, golden orbital perimeter arcs
ledger heart approach: midnight lavender folded paper plane, a bronze cosmic-heart silhouette and luminous thin constellation filaments

story.title: 借来的灯
lines: 旧城每一个愿望，都在总账里借了一缕火。
还清债的人消失了。名字被撕下，成了下一盏灯的灯芯。
你带着一张空白愿页入夜，决定沿十一重旧账找回他们。

story.title: 第六重 · 守名判殿
lines: 守名大判守着一架永远不平的秤。
他不是在收债。他把归还的名字藏起来，拖延总账的苏醒。
要让所有人回来，你必须连自己的愿望也放上秤。

story.title: 第七至十重 · 灯与影
lines: 判殿倒下，四重封契同时解开。
每一重旧账都有两位守债者；他们争夺同一盏心灯。
把路走完，才能回答：愿望属于许愿的人，还是记账的神？

story.title: 第十一重 · 万愿天穹
lines: 三十余间愿室悬在总账的空白页上。
六道守债者的连门之后，最后一笔账等待你的名字。
不是替所有人偿债，而是带他们重新做一次选择。

story.title: 账尽，灯未灭
lines: 万愿总账的铜心裂开，旧城的名字像纸雨一样落下。
你没有取得神的位子。你把空白愿页一张张还给夜归的人。
纸童找回父亲的称呼，铃师听见真正的回声，灯客终于熄灭借来的火。
傩面摘下面具，伞灵走出雨，墨吏写下第一行不需利息的字。
此后，灯下仍有人许愿。愿望不再是一笔债。
